Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a plan to encourage medical students to work with patients with developmental disabilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to training medical students to work with patientswith developmental disabilities; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The University of Washington medical schoolshall develop a plan to train students to work with patients withdevelopmental disabilities. The plan must include incentives forstudents to undertake the training. The medical school must presentthe plan, including costs, to the appropriate committees of thelegislature no later than November 30, 2007.
